name: RotateShape
comment: Rotates each vertex of an n×2 shape counterclockwise by deg degrees. shapeArr is column 1 x and column 2 y, in row order. center is an optional 1×2 row (x, y). If center is omitted, the shape rotates about its centroid. A zero-area shape then returns #DIV/0!. A row that is not two numbers returns #VALUE! or #REF!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
